heavenlyrestriction.skill.prospector.des: Toggle: +50% mining speed and +3 effective Fortune, added to your tool's Fortune. Stone and deepslate have a 1% chance to yield an extra resource when mined with a suitable tool. When mastered, the find chance becomes 1.5% and rarer materials become more likely. Sense ore deposits within 32 blocks through terrain, including magic ore; ore types have distinct marker colors and glyphs. Press Refine to open Tensura's refining menu. No aura or magicule cost.
heavenlyrestriction.skill.exponentiation: Passive, In Slot. Raise beneficial final stats and outputs to the power of 1.2 while equipped in your active preset: damage, HP/SHP healing, aura/magicule recovery, defenses, elemental bonuses, senses, learning/mastery, EP awards before the race split, non-energy capacities, mining, attack/casting speed, loot quantities and XP gains. Maximum aura/magicules and separate permanent aura/magicule gain multipliers, movement-related values, costs, cooldowns and requirements are excluded. Fractions below 1 are preserved, and native chance, stack and progression limits apply. No activation or upkeep cost.
heavenlyrestriction.skill.split_mind.des: Toggle: +9 learning and mastery point gain, native Thought Acceleration and Chant Annulment (mastered magic casts instantly). Magic Assignment: choose one of your learned aspectual or spiritual magics. Auto-Cast: independently toggle automatic casting at the nearest visible hostile mob or combat opponent within 32 blocks. Normal magic costs, casting requirements and cooldowns apply. Allies and protected players are excluded. When Split Mind is mastered, Auto-Cast costs 25% fewer magicules; aura costs and manual casting costs are unchanged.
heavenlyrestriction.split_mind.invalid: This learned magic is no longer available.

heavenlyrestriction.skill.critical_merch: Compound Interest [Passive, Toggle]: Double critical-hit damage, then roll a 50% chance to double it again. Each success allows another roll, ending on failure, up to 100 additional rolls per critical. Guaranteed Profit [Active, Press]: Spend 1,000 magicules to prepare your next 10 landed hits as criticals. 20-second cooldown; recasting refreshes the count to 10. The passive can be toggled independently. Native damage types and defenses still apply.

heavenlyrestriction.skill.hephaestus.des: Master of the Crucible [Passive, Toggle]: +100% mining speed, stacking Fortune V, 3% material finds and ore sight. Personally forged equipment gains +20% attack damage / armor / toughness and 50% reduced durability damage. While active, prevent new curse generation on all equipment; existing curses and Tsukumogami generation are unchanged. Divine Forge: crafting, native refining, engraving, storage, material-based tempering and repair. Living Arsenal: deploy up to six actual melee weapons in a prismatic autonomous formation. Magnum Opus: designate one personally forged masterpiece for +50% item stats and 75% reduced wear, replacing ordinary forge bonuses. Synthesis: mastered Prospector + Godly Craftsman, True Demon Lord / True Hero, and personally forged Netherite or Hihiirokane equipment. No EP requirement. Acquisition cost applies after awakening; see Synthesis for the configured price.

heavenlyrestriction.skill.metis.descript: Unified Intellect [Passive, Toggle]: Chant Annulment, Thought Acceleration and +19 learning/mastery points. Automatically analyze nearby visible magic circles using Tensura’s normal copy rules. Parallel Matrix: assign three learned aspectual/spiritual magics with their modes and priorities; mastery unlocks a fourth thread. Autonomous Sage: independent background casting, self-healing when needed and support without redundant buffs. Automatic casts cost 30% fewer magicules, or 40% fewer when mastered. Optimal Solution: prioritize effective assigned spells and avoid analyzed nullifications while Unified Intellect is active. Toggle Optimal Solution in the matrix. Analytical Appraisal: level 20/40. Analysis: guaranteed eligible copies, including resistances and nullifications, subject to native protections; 5-second cooldown, or 2 seconds mastered. Retains native refining and crafting. Synthesis: mastered Split Mind + Great Sage, completed True Demon Lord/True Hero awakening, three learned magics and a configurable permanent-magicule cost; no EP requirement.

heavenlyrestriction.skill.tyche.descript:
[Passive - Toggle] Loaded Dice: criticals start at ×4, chain further doublings and reroll one failure. Against All Odds: below half HP, progressively gain up to +50% attack damage and +25 evasion points.
[Passive - True] Fate Insurance: survive an eligible fatal attack, fully recover HP/SHP/magicules/aura and reset other ability cooldowns. Each damage type works once per five-minute history window. Insurance never resets itself.
[Active - Press] Guaranteed Dividend: ten critical hits, each using the better of two payout rolls. Shift: synthesis/history.
[Active - Press] The House Always Wins: a 16-block fortune domain for 15 seconds; suppress enemy criticals, bypass dodge inside it and gain a 25% chance to evade ordinary incoming attacks.
